Sports · India

Spain Wins FIFA World Cup 2026, India Celebrates

Spain defeated Argentina 1-0 in the FIFA World Cup 2026 final. The victory has sparked widespread celebrations and watch parties across India, with some states announcing holidays for schools and colleges. Award winners from the tournament included Kylian Mbappé and Rodri. Former US President Donald Trump was present at the trophy presentation and was reportedly encouraged to step aside from the podium.
